candidate.profile_limit: Profiled warmup only; cumulative process timings can overlap and are not a cycle-time decomposition.

default_cadence_model.assumptions: One complete probe cycle per interval; remaining cycles armed; startup probes immediately. A capture group with four responses of 4096 tokens bounds collection in this workload. Within-run noise, admission rejection and async overlap limit extrapolation.

baseline.profile_limit: Profiled warmup only; cumulative process timings can overlap and are not a cycle-time decomposition.

limits: Serialized native core plus normal metric emission on Snowball; persistent caches and changing weights, fixed timing advantages and masks. One allocation per implementation. Descriptive Student-t paired log intervals assume approximately independent normal log differences; Welch comparisons omit unmeasured allocation effects. No production async throughput or learning-gain claim. Timer fields can overlap; memory device peaks sample every 0.1 seconds and host peaks are cumulative.
